decisions.reason: As a door lever handle family it lies squarely in the firm's core architectural hardware knowledge base and system capabilities, so management is likely to keep it unless it undertakes limited portfolio cleanup.

This door handle design also fits the firm's established design and engineering competences, but as a more style-specific offer it faces a somewhat higher risk of being replaced by newer designs than a broader family line.

The electronic access system is a flagship aligned with the firm's strategic move toward digital building organisation, and the firm has the related technical, innovation and learning capacity needed to improve and commercialise it further.
